label: Beginner · Lesson 15
title: His, her and ’s
intro: Whose is it? His, her, our, their and ’s. Today’s words and what we learnt before.
intro_uz: Kimniki? His, her, our, their va ’s. Bugungi so’zlar va oldingi mavzular.
message: Beginner · Lesson 15 · His, her and ’s. Do it before the next lesson. Rasmga oling yoki chop eting.

parts.title: His, her, our, their or ’s?
items: Aziz is my friend. {His|Her} bag is black.
We are students. {Our|Their} teacher is Clive.
They have a dog. {Our|Their} dog is black.

parts.title: Write his, her, our, their or whose
items: Bobur has a ball. ___ ball is red.
Madina has an umbrella. ___ umbrella is blue.
We have a cat. ___ cat is black.
My parents have a car. ___ car is white.
___ bag is this? It’s Lola’s bag.
My sister has a hat. ___ hat is green.

parts.title: Uzbek → English
items: Aziz — mening akam. Uning iti oq.

items.prompt: Write 4 sentences about your family or friends with his, her, our, their or ’s.
items.hint: Example: My brother’s name is Bobur. His bag is black.
